title: Pin test never drives Save — stale-save persistence of the NEW contact is asserted nowhere through the input path
detail: Test stops after dict-write and re-render assertions; no UserSavedRefcheckEdit dispatch, so 'Save persists the NEW contact' (acceptance #1, the stale-save harm) is unpinned. A future save-path re-key would slip through.
recommended_fix: Extend the test: after simulate.input, dispatch UserSavedRefcheckEdit("rc-1") and assert the save effect carries the typed email (or inflight-marked), tying the assertion to save.

title: Substitute trio typing and reorder/refetch survival unexercised — changed lines are shared but only the Correct path is pinned
detail: Fixture is one AwaitingCorrection call in Correct mode. No test types into the substitute trio (empty-prefill branch, substitute save endpoint) nor refetches/reorders rows — guard-listed acceptance #2 and typed-value-survival conditions.
recommended_fix: Add a second pin test: Objected call with can_substitute_referee, open Substitute, simulate.input on the email, assert dict write under reference_call_id and substitute-save dispatch.
